analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 45.6 remains in neutral territory, up from 36.2 five days ago but lacking further upward momentum after exiting oversold. MACD histogram at -1.6003 shows improvement but remains negative. Volume ratio at 0.08, significantly below the 5-day average, indicating low conviction. Price is consolidating around the SMA20 at $573.46, showing no clear direction. Weekly ADX at 13.3 signals a lack of trend. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation) — Continued sideways movement within the narrow range between short-term support($561.52) and resistance($599.66); consider entry after direction confirmation.
